 WEST VIRGINIA (WCHS) — Thousands of Optimum customers across the state of West Virginia experienced service outages or disruptions on Wednesday, the company said.
 According to an Optimum spokesperson, the outage occurred due to a third-party cutting a line.
 “Some Optimum customers in West Virginia are experiencing a disruption to services due to a cut to their infrastructure caused by a third party. We are actively engaged with that third-party provider as they work to make repairs. We appreciate our customers’ patience as their crews work to resolve this matter as quickly and safely as possible. We understand how important reliable connectivity is to our community and sincerely apologize for the inconvenience this disruption may be causing.” Optimum said service for customers can be affected when a third-party provider damages shared or leased infrastructure.
 The company said they would provide updates on service restoration as more information becomes available.
